pages.text: The plain tube points wherever you place it, which is usually what you want. When it is not, there is a tube per direction: down, up, north, south, east and west.$(br2)A directed tube ignores the face you click and always points its own way, so you can lay a long horizontal run without thinking about which side of each block you are aiming at.

pages.title: Swapping
pages.text: Every direction converts into every other one, one for one, and back into the plain tube. Drop one in a crafting grid and take out the direction you wanted.$(br2)They stack in nines and fours as well, so a stack converts in a couple of clicks rather than sixty-four.
